name: Crushing Dissonance interrupts casting enemies within its 8 yd radius and applies its 30 sec cooldown (#3722)
contract: Original Crushing Dissonance 804056 interrupts casting enemies within its eight-yard radius and has a
thirty-second cooldown. Its native effect68 uses its original 3000 ms duration to prohibit the interrupted
school; this scenario verifies interruption and range, while the three-second lockout remains source/data
The unchanged Scholomance Dark Summoner 11582 SmartAI casts original Summon Risen Lackey 17618 on itself
after 2–5 seconds and repeats after 5–7 seconds. That Shadow cast lasts 4000 ms, uses SILENCE prevention and
has interrupt flags 0x9. Its other spells include two-second Curse of Blood 12279 and five-second Drain Life
17620; an arbitrary active cast can already be near completion.
Wait for 17618 with at least 2500 ms remaining, allow 500 ms of native updates, and require at least 1500 ms
before the interrupt. The nearby summon must stop within 500 ms, before natural completion could satisfy the
assertion. The summon twenty yards away must keep more than 1400 ms after the same ordinary interrupt spell.
Engage the near target through a real melee swing at three yards. Engage the far target with normal Eldritch
Shock 808043, whose original zero global cooldown allows the subsequent interrupt. Preserve the enemies'
original damage and AI timers; a health-only setup and survival assertions keep the observer alive. Check
the original thirty-second cooldown before resetting it for the independent range leg.

The original summon cast still has time remaining before the radius check
The combat observer remains alive during the interrupt/radius observation
